name: 01-cw-monogram
prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Design a genuinely polished contemporary identity for CodeWeekend, an inclusive developer learning community. Produce one restrained landscape logo concept sheet, off-white #F7F4EC ground, generous empty space, precise flat vector aesthetic, no gradients, textures, shadows, mockups, explanatory prose or fake measurement annotations. Name must read exactly "codeweekend" in lowercase, custom confident geometric sans serif, clean and friendly with carefully balanced kerning, not bubbly or playful. Layout: one large horizontal lockup centered in upper half, bottom left large symbol alone, bottom center small solid black symbol to prove monochrome, bottom right tiny app icon on dark square. Palette ink #182B29 and warm vermilion #F0643B with cream. DO NOT use kite, diamond, angle brackets, curly braces, coding chevrons, mountain, rocket, circuit or generic swoosh. Strong 24px silhouette. All repeats must be the same design.
Direction 01: CW COMMON THREAD. Invent a distinctive compact lowercase cw monogram, one integrated bold continuous geometric form. The open c transitions seamlessly into a low w, even weight, slightly softened outside corners, straight flat ends. It should feel like two learners working side by side. C and W must be legible, not interlaced tangles. The entire monogram is ink green, with a tiny separate vermilion square set just above the top-right as a punctuation detail. Wordmark all dark ink.

Palette ink #182B29 and warm vermilion #F0643B with cream. DO NOT use kite, diamond, angle brackets, curly braces, coding chevrons, mountain, rocket, circuit or generic swoosh. Direction 02: WEEKEND W. Build an ownable chunky W from TWO identical broad U-shaped troughs connected together, upright vertical sides, square outside geometry with subtly rounded bottom inner corners. Think minimal engineered extrusion or a bold folded paper strip, but absolutely flat 2D and not interwoven. The left stem, center stem, right stem rise evenly. The two rounded rectangular negative-space channels create the W. Simple iconic compact silhouette. Make the whole symbol vermilion. Wordmark dark ink. No c anywhere in symbol. No diagonal chevrons.

Direction 03: SHARED BLOCKS. Use ink green for all but one top-right vermilion block. Chunky, architectural, solid, meaningful negative space. Wordmark dark ink.
